name: La Concha Beach
desc: A crescent of sand so perfect it feels rented from a postcard. Costs nothing to stand there plotting the rest of your life.

name: Monte Igueldo
desc: Rattly 1912 funicular to a fairground stuck in time, with the best bay view money barely buys. Bring a few coins and some vertigo.

name: Monte Urgull
desc: Free hilltop hike past old cannons to a giant statue watching the surf roll in. The city's cheapest throne.

name: Peine del Viento
desc: Rusted steel combs bolted into rocks where waves explode. On stormy nights the ground hisses under you. Free, feral, unforgettable.

name: San Telmo Museoa
desc: Basque history tucked into a 16th-century convent. A few bucks to understand why this tiny city out-eats everyone.

name: Aquarium Donostia
desc: Walk a glass tunnel while sharks commute overhead. Old-school, harborside, and worth skipping two pintxos for.

name: Zurriola Beach
desc: The surfy, scruffy beach across the river where Gros kids paddle out at dawn. Free front-row seats to other people's wipeouts.

name: Miramar Palace Gardens
desc: Royal lawns strung between the two beaches. Bring bread, cheese, and delusions of aristocracy — the view is included.

name: Buen Pastor Cathedral
desc: The neo-gothic spire anchoring the skyline. Slip in for quiet and stained glass; the price of awe here is zero.

name: Plaza de la Constitución
desc: Numbered balconies left over from its bullring days. Order one drink, hold the table, watch the old town do its thing.
